status: Independent NVLink and two-node GIN confirmations complete; performance is workload dependent. See the separate matched vLLM serving comparison.
scope: Communication only; no expert GEMMs or serving throughput. Initialization, JIT and graph capture excluded; graph replay included. One captured graph per token extent, not one maximum-capacity graph.
metric: Each block uses the maximum Attention-rank CUDA-event latency per exchange. Each process uses the median of five blocks. Change is median of three paired process ratios minus one; positive means slower. Masked132 is a fixed control, not a claim that132 is optimal for every shape. Tuned controls and independent routes remain to be confirmed.

registered_capacity.definition: Logical registered transport-buffer capacity summed across four ranks; excludes other allocations and is not total VRAM.

correctness.scope: NVLink H2048/H4096 BF16/FP8, eager/graphs, changing live counts and routes, empty/skewed/asymmetric storage, poisoned/reused slots, delayed peers, mixed collectors and numerical edge cases
correctness.status: passed; GIN additionally covers eight H100s, BF16/FP8 hybrid/direct, capacities128/2048, changing-count graphs and delayed/poisoned reuse

interpretation: Source packing/count kernel median fell from90.08us to57.78us after grid132to528; all CUDA SASS is byte-identical to parent e376.
Request/grouping is63.01us slower, return64.46us faster and source completion6.79us slower than Masked132 in fresh phase medians.
Masked dispatch overlaps its copy epilogue. Durations include waits/overlap and do not isolate network, counting or achieved hardware bandwidth.
nsight.figure: Representative exchanges closest to each trace median, not a stack of independent kernel medians. Profiled diagnostics are separate from unprofiled timing.

independent_nvlink.hardware: 4 H100 80GB, Hopper SM90, one NVLink domain,2Attention+2FFN
independent_nvlink.execution: graph per token extent; runtime replay included; initialization/JIT/capture/GEMMs excluded
independent_nvlink.method: Three fresh balanced process pairs per arm; process median of five blocks of1000 exchanges after1000 warmups. Each block uses maximum Attention-rank CUDA-event latency. Structured routes are deterministic; only random routes change with seed.
independent_nvlink.summary_method: Equal-cell geometric mean of each cell's median paired process ratio; descriptive, not serving-workload weighted or a confidence bound. No comparator selected on validation data.
independent_nvlink.cell_arm_arrays: 15 block latencies in microseconds per arm: five blocks for repeat0, then five for repeat1, then five for repeat2. Process latency is the median of its five blocks.
independent_nvlink.resource_note: DeepEP num_sms controls transport; local epilogues use the fullGPU. Directional132 is a base launch grid, not an equal hardware resource cap.
independent_nvlink.memory_note: Logical registered communication capacity summed across four ranks; excludes expert/receive tensors, caller allocations and total VRAM.

caveats: Instrumented diagnostic times are not official latency numbers.
GPU kernel durations can contain waits; Systems does not establish a bandwidth or occupancy cause.
Global phase boundaries count concurrent work once.
No source changes, candidate tuning or new unprofiled timings.

setup.rank_roles: FFN ranks 0–3 and Attention ranks 4–7 occupy separate nodes
setup.network: One shared RoCEv2 rail; not a four-rail throughput experiment

hybrid_modes.on: Hybrid NVLink forwarding within each domain plus inter-domain GIN transfers
hybrid_modes.off: Direct GIN peer communication without the hybrid intra-node forwarding path

directional.label: 132-block base grid
directional.semantics: Base CTA grid for local kernels; not a reserved-SM or simultaneous-occupancy cap. GIN send grids are derived separately from peers and stripes.

masked.semantics: 24/132 configure DeepEP transport work. Local epilogues use an independent full-GPU 132-SM grid, so matching numeric settings does not impose equal resource caps.

selection.policy: One fixed candidate grid and one fixed Masked transport setting per payload/mode, selected by equal-cell geometric mean over three routes and six token extents; lower-setting tie break. The envelope is separately selected per cell from training only, not from confirmation.

labels.trained_fixed: Training-selected fixed control (24 in all four payload/mode groups); aliases its explicit control rows
labels.trained_envelope: Training-selected 24/132 control per cell; diagnostic reference, not a single deployable setting

confirmation.balanced_order: Three independent Latin-balanced repeats; each arm occupies each order position once
confirmation.execution: One CUDA graph per token extent; fixed-capacity varying-live graph is correctness evidence only
confirmation.metric: Per block, maximum CUDA-event elapsed time across the four Attention ranks, divided by replays; process value is median of five blocks
confirmation.aggregate_geomean_definition: Across 18 equally weighted cells, 100*(1-exp(mean(log(1-median_paired_reduction_pct/100)))); per-repeat aggregates instead use that repeat's latency ratios
confirmation.timed: Actual graph replay, directional exchange/packing/signaling/reduction or Masked dispatch/combine
confirmation.excluded: Initialization, allocation/setup, graph capture, JIT and expert GEMMs; constant expert outputs are prepared outside timing
confirmation.route_seed_scope: The seed changes random routes; strided/skew are deterministic patterns with fresh independent process repetitions
confirmation.control_plane_events: One OAuth expiry during result fetch; completed result recovered without remeasurement and original remaining indices resumed. A later proactive credential refresh interrupted no process.

correctness.matrix: BF16/FP8 x hybrid/direct x capacities 128/2048 on eight GPUs
checks: changing routes/live counts and zero work
delayed FFN worker and delayed Attention reader
exact/reusable receives and poisoned receipt reuse

registered_communication_capacity.scope: Eight-GPU summed registered transport capacity only; not total VRAM, virtual address reservation or PyTorch scratch

two_node_gin.observation_encoding: The 288 comparison rows retain every original field except duplicated raw-block arrays. candidate_observation_ids/control_observation_ids index the 648 observations, reconstructing those arrays exactly and preserving every three-process pair and all five blocks.
limits: Only the tested H100 topology, settings and communication-only workloads are measured
No serving throughput, GEMM overlap, one-max-graph prefill or universal non-degradation claim
Five blocks within a process are correlated, not five independent experiments
Three same-sign process pairs alone provide weak evidence (one-sided sign probability 1/8 under a symmetric null); no 95% confidence claim
No new GIN trace or optimization was launched from mixed-sign confirmation cells
